title: A complex CM-elliptic Ribet section with infinitely many fibre-torsion points and no proper subgroup-scheme containment
author: Daniel Bertrand; Bas Edixhoven
work: Pink’s conjecture on unlikely intersections and families of semi-abelian varieties
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.126
difficulty_reason: Canonical antisymmetric Poincaré trivialization creates a section above a nonzero Rosati-skew endomorphism. Generalized-Jacobian divisor norms and Weil reciprocity establish torsion specialization, while non-torsion extension classes force the cyclic section multiples to be Zariski dense in the full semiabelian family.
